label: Compare the timing and form of a hearing
explanation: Fuentes examines prejudgment seizure of household goods and the opportunity to contest the deprivation. Mathews examines termination of disability benefits and the sufficiency of written procedures followed by a later evidentiary hearing. The comparison asks how the private interest, risk of error, and government burden shape procedure. A civil creditor’s seizure and an agency benefits decision involve different facts and procedural systems; neither case makes a single hearing format appropriate for every deprivation.
